usedFor: Slack is where someone drops an app worth watching, and Applyra tracks App Store and Google Play rankings. A “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack can run “Track App” in Applyra to start tracking it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Track App” in Applyra
bestTemplate.why: A teammate posts a store ID in a channel and tracking starts without opening Applyra. This trigger is pushed when the message lands, while “New Thread Message” is polling.

watchOut: “Track App” needs a store ID plus a country and a language, so a free-form message is not enough on its own. Agree one message format for the channel.
